lines.en: label nikispringnightgen:
scene nikispringnightgen
I decide to spend the night with one of the only people who really {i}gets{/i} me. But the problem with that is that she is one of the only people who {i}really gets me.{/i}
lines.zh: 我决定跟为数不多真正{i}懂{/i}我的人之一共度今夜。可问题也正在于此——她恰恰是那为数不多{i}真正懂我{/i}的人之一。

lines.en: And with the state I've been in lately, I'm not sure if that's a good thing or not. Because if someone spends their night reciting my flaws, what am {i}I{/i} supposed to do?
lines.zh: 以我最近这副状态，我拿不准这究竟算好事还是坏事。因为如果有人整晚都在历数我的缺点，那{i}我{/i}又能怎么办？

lines.en: Granted, any time Niki does that, it's out of love. And I know she means no harm by it.
lines.zh: 当然，Niki 每次那样做都是出于爱。我也知道她并无恶意。

lines.en: But I see reflections of my mistakes in everything already. I don't need someone to point at them and remind me that they're there when what I want to do is ignore them.
lines.zh: 可我已经在万事万物里看见自己那些过错的倒影了。我明明只想对它们视而不见，不需要有人指着它们提醒我它们还在那儿。

lines.en: Regardless, we tuck ourselves into the corner of some bar near Niki's studio, where she assures me that her identity won't cause any problems.
lines.zh: 无论如何，我们还是在 Niki 工作室附近某间酒吧的角落里坐了下来。她向我保证，她的身份不会惹出什么麻烦。

lines.en: But I kind of wish it would.
Because at least then I know everyone wouldn't be looking at me.
lines.zh: 因为那样的话，至少我就能确定，所有人看的都不是我。

lines.en: scene black
I spend too much time thinking about myself and I'm unable to have any fun. But, let's face it, I've never been good at that to begin with.
lines.zh: 我在自己身上花了太多心思，以至于没法玩得尽兴。不过说真的，我本来也从来不擅长这个。

lines.en: We chat about the past and whether or not it has a chance of ever becoming the present again.
lines.zh: 我们聊起过去，聊它还有没有机会重新变成现在。

lines.en: To a certain extent, Niki thinks it already has.
lines.zh: 在某种程度上，Niki 认为它已经变回来了。

lines.en: But to a greater extent, I just want to spoon my eyes out and dissolve them in a chemical solution.
lines.zh: 但在更大的程度上，我只想把眼珠子挖出来，泡进化学溶剂里溶掉。
